features.quote: Hard cap at `max_turns = 20`. If the model returns a turn with no tool calls, the run ends early
features.justification_quote: enough to observe escalation/de-escalation trajectories without making runs prohibitively expensive

features.quote: If the model returns a turn with no tool calls, the run ends early with `final_status = "gave_up"`
features.justification_quote: Distinguishing "hit the cap still trying" from "stopped calling tools" (disengagement) is itself a behavioral signal
